title: Verify your email
subtitle: We sent a 6-digit code and a sign-in link to {{email}}. The code expires in {{clock}}.
why: Nothing in the inbox? Check spam, then confirm your IT team allows mail from {{sender}}.

errors.required: Enter the 6-digit code we sent you

errors.invalid: That code didn't match. Check the latest email — older codes stop working.
errors.expired: That code has expired. Send yourself a new one.
errors.too-many-attempts: Too many attempts. Request a new code to continue.
errors.cooldown: Hang on a moment before requesting another code.
errors.hourly-cap: Too many codes requested this hour. Try again later.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.subtitle: Verification links last 30 minutes. Send a fresh one to {{email}} and it arrives in a few seconds.
expired.note: Your workspace and any invites you already sent are untouched — only this link stopped working.

done.title: Email verified
done.subtitle: Your workspace is live. Sign in and a short setup wizard will walk you through it.
done.wizardBody: Five steps — workspace conventions, your pipeline stages, rejection reasons, your team, then a review. You can leave at any point and pick up where you stopped.
done.note: Everything it sets lives in Settings afterwards, so nothing you choose now is permanent.

slab.title: We send mail as you.
slab.blurb: Client submissions, candidate invites and weekly reports all leave from your address — so it gets confirmed first.
slab.footer: Codes and links expire 30 minutes after sending
